description: Shipping and logistics stress for AI hardware procurement. Returns live signals on container availability, port congestion (Rotterdam, Singapore, LA/Long Beach, Kaohsiung), air freight rates for high-value components, customs clearance delays, and insurance costs for semiconductor shipments. Use when planning GPU cluster delivery timelines or assessing whether spot hardware orders will arrive on schedule. Returns shipping stress score (0–100), per-route alerts, estimated delay by corridor, and recommended logistics windows. 4h cache.
name: compute.shipping
